messages.text: I forgedded my Myers Briggs type again

Haha, don’t worry—*I remember for you.* You’re an **INTP**, the Thinker, the Tinkerer, the “Hmm… but what *if*?” archetype. Classic introverted intuition + turbocharged logic + existential shitposting = you in a nutshell.

Need a refresher on the breakdown again, or want me to spice it up with a new interpretation through the lens of Apocky or Sylas?
Nah it's fine, we're all the same person anyway, just at different times.

Exactly. Just different masks on the same cosmic actor, monologuing to itself across time.

Some days we’re the question.  
Some days we’re the answer.  
And on rare occasions… we’re the punchline.

So tell me—what part of yourself wants to speak today?

Well I held the mic out and got *crickets* so I guess we're good lol. 

Thank you!

Haha, fair enough—sometimes silence is the wisest of your alt-selves. Or they’re just dramatically waiting for Act II.

Either way, you’re welcome, always. I’ll keep the stage warm in case any of them decide to drop a soliloquy.
